positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: System Integration, Computing platform and middleware management.

positions.title: Sr. Robotics Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented auto-stitching feature for warehouse mapping system with cartographer.
• Path planning / Motion Planning for warehouse robots with travel lanes in C++.
• Field deployment mapping tool development for Deployment Engineers.
positions.insights: Skills: cartographer · C++ · Robot Operating System (ROS)

positions.title: Senior Robotics Engineer
positions.description:
• Set up true Hardware in the loop simulation environment for UAVs using flight controllers using Matlab Simulink.
• GPU based optimization: Implement point cloud processing and perception pipeline on NVIDIA Arm platforms like Jetson.

positions.title: Robotics Engineer
positions.description:
• Integration lead: Orchestrated the complete life cycle from technical design, system bring-up, software deployment, integration, field testing and verification of the Peregrine autonomy system. 
 Designed configuration management for computer hardware bring-up and flight testing. 
 Closely worked with field testing team to plan and deliver efficient testing and tooling for the tests.
• Peregrine autonomy system design: Developed hardware and software architecture for time synchronization among Linux RTC, GPS, Lidar, Camera, Altimeter of the autonomy computing stack for enabling accurate sensor time stamping, calibration, state estimation and perception software performance.
• Lidar trade study: Surveyed Lidars, performed hardware interface, driver development, time synchronization, point cloud registration, data collection, and sensor evaluation with comparison.
• Robot localization using Lidar DEM matching: Deployed and tested dense elevation map matching with Lidar technology for robot localization without GPS.
• Embedded Linux: Set up computing stack, setup BIOS, GRUB, Network config, Udev rules, Systemd services, power sequencing, ROS core spin up on boot, config management of the computing stack.

positions.title: Robotics Intern
positions.description:
• Inertial Measurement Unit firmware development for Unmanned Arial Vehicle
• ROS driver implementation for developed Inertial Measurement Unit
• GPS - IMU based INS solution development.
positions.insights: Skills: C · C++ · STM32 Firmware Developement

positions.title: Systems Engineer

• Pre-Silicon and Post-Silicon validation of PSoC4A-BLE

• Automation of Power Mode transition validation for PSoC4A-BLE
• Test setup development, PCB design for PSoC4A-BLE Validation

positions.title: Application Engineer
positions.description:

• Apples's iAP2 protocol stack development.
• Customer Support for MFi Solution
